product_overview: BKI Academy Certificate Management System is an internal platform for tracking training batches, managing participants, and monitoring the certificate lifecycle from pending to completion. It gives operations teams and managers a unified view of workload, delays, PIC ownership, and process history.
core_goals: Create and manage training batches with participant data
Track qualification and attendance certificates through each workflow stage
Assign and monitor PIC responsibility for certificate processing
View operational dashboards and performance reports
Review audit history of certificate status changes

features.name: Authentication & Access Control
features.description: Users sign in to access the internal certificate management system and can sign out to end their session.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to / -> Use demo quick fill -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /dashboard -> Sign out -> See login page

features.name: Unified Dashboard
features.description: Users review a consolidated operational overview with KPI summaries, pipeline views, and exportable reporting.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Switch to the integrated overview tab -> Review KPI cards and recent activity -> Export the report
Navigate to /dashboard -> Switch to the leads and waiting list tab -> Review urgent follow-up items and demand indicators
Navigate to /dashboard -> Switch to the certificate tracker tab -> Review certificate SLA status and pipeline distribution

features.name: Training Management
features.description: Users search, filter, and create training batches, then open a batch to manage its detail view.
user_flows: Navigate to /trainings -> Search by program name or batch code -> Review matching training batches
Navigate to /trainings -> Filter by status or learning method -> Review the filtered training list
Navigate to /trainings -> Open the new batch flow -> Fill in the training batch details -> Submit the form -> See the new training batch in the list
Navigate to /trainings -> Open a training batch -> View the batch detail page

features.name: Certificate Life-Cycle & Workflow
features.description: Users monitor certificates globally or within a training batch, move them through processing stages, and inspect individual certificate details.
user_flows: Navigate to /certificates -> Filter by training, certificate type, or PIC -> Review the certificate table
Navigate to /certificates -> Update a certificate status from the table -> See the certificate move to the new stage
Navigate to /trainings -> Open a training batch -> Move a certificate card across workflow stages -> See the certificate update in the board
Navigate to /trainings -> Open a training batch -> Select a certificate card -> Review its detail timeline and notes -> Update the certificate status

features.name: Leads CRM & Quick Input
features.description: Users register prospective trainees, advance lead stages, and launch pre-filled WhatsApp outreach.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/leads -> Open the new lead form -> Fill in contact name, phone, company, program, and estimated seats -> Submit the form -> See the lead added to the pipeline
Navigate to /crm/leads -> Change a lead status -> See the lead move to the next pipeline stage
Navigate to /crm/leads -> Open a WhatsApp template -> Review the pre-filled message -> Launch the chat
Navigate to /crm/leads -> Select a lead row -> Review the audit trail in the detail drawer

features.name: Waiting List Demand Barometer
features.description: Users review accumulated training demand by program, refine it by waiting reason, and bridge demand into active batches.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/waiting-list -> Review demand ranking by program -> Identify the highest-demand training topics
Navigate to /crm/waiting-list -> Filter by waiting reason -> Review the filtered waiting list
Navigate to /crm/waiting-list -> Add a waiting lead to a batch -> See the lead bridged into active training

features.name: Daily Follow-up Work Queue
features.description: Users manage follow-up tasks by priority and reschedule or contact prospects directly.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/follow-ups -> Switch between overdue, today, and link sent tabs -> Review the prioritized task queue
Navigate to /crm/follow-ups -> Reschedule a follow-up for tomorrow -> See the follow-up date move by one day
Navigate to /crm/follow-ups -> Launch WhatsApp chat for a contact -> Continue the follow-up conversation

features.name: Master Directory (Companies & Contacts)
features.description: Users maintain partner company records and contact directories for outreach and account management.
user_flows: Navigate to /directory/companies -> Add a new company -> Fill in the company details -> Submit the form -> See the company in the directory
Navigate to /directory/companies -> Search and filter companies by industry -> Review matching partner companies
Navigate to /directory/contacts -> Review the contact list -> Open WhatsApp for a contact -> Continue communication with that person

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: Users update profile details, security preferences, notification settings, and system configuration.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/profile -> Update the profile name -> Save changes -> See the updated profile information
Navigate to /settings/security -> Change the password details -> Save changes -> See the security settings update
Navigate to /settings/notifications -> Adjust email and system notification preferences -> Save changes -> See the new notification preferences
Navigate to /settings/system -> Review SLA thresholds and database configuration -> Save changes -> See the updated system settings

features.name: Operational Reports & Audit Trail
features.description: Users inspect certificate performance metrics and review a full history of status changes and certificate movements.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Review average completion time, late certificate count, and total certificates -> Inspect performance charts
Navigate to /history-logs -> Review the audit trail of certificate changes -> Trace status movements and notes over time
Navigate to /reports -> Compare monthly completion and delay reasons -> Review operational bottlenecks

routes.description: User login page with demo and custom credentials
Unified platform dashboard with module tabs (All, Leads, Certificates) and KPI summaries
Training batch list management with search, filter, and creation modal
Training batch detail view, participant management, and certificate workflow Kanban
Global certificate tracker with SLA monitoring, status filters, and bulk actions
Certificate operational reports and SLA performance analytics
Comprehensive audit trail of status changes and certificate movements
Leads CRM pipeline with quick input modal, status transitions, WhatsApp templates, and detail drawer
Waiting list demand barometer, reason categorization, and batch matching helper
Daily follow-up work queue categorized by Overdue, Hari Ini, and Link Terkirim
Course demand ranking, lead source distribution, and PIC workload analysis
Master partner company directory with creation modal and contact counts
Customer contact directory with quick WhatsApp link and position tags
User profile settings and name update
Password change and authentication security settings
System SLA threshold and Supabase database configuration
